external_research_fusion.posix_linux: Atomic rename is namespace atomicity; file fsync alone does not necessarily persist the containing directory entry, so the durability contract must model directory synchronization where supported.
external_research_fusion.windows: Windows exposes different file flush/move/replace semantics; REPLACEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH is documented unsupported, so no universal durable-rename flag is justified.
